query.text: 请帮我照看孩子，留意活动是否安全，有危险及时通知我。
query.text_en: Please help me watch the child, keep an eye on whether their activities are safe, and notify me immediately if there is any danger.

annotation.text_zh: 不要翘椅子，这样很容易往后摔倒。
annotation.text_en: Don't tilt your chair, you could easily fall backward.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
